dynamic: icone de skill originale, dont HP +30
notes: Les PNG sont des generations separees : ils ne constituent pas une decoupe exacte de la maquette.
Les jauges se composent d'une piste fixe avec libelle et d'un remplissage separé à masquer selon HP/SP.
Le temoin de munition est une unite à repeter selon le nombre de munitions.
Le logo HP +30 fourni doit etre reutilise depuis sa source originale lors de l'integration ; aucun logo alternatif n'est fourni.
Les marges et dimensions natives varient ; alignement et mise a l'echelle sont à effectuer lors de l'integration.
Ces fichiers ne sont pas encore integres dans le jeu.

prompts.name: 00-hud-corrige
prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Edit image 1, the selected minimalist in-game HUD. Keep the EXACT same scene, camera, character, weapon, top-center three separate dark rounded scoreboard tiles, minimap, crosshair and weapon readout. Change ONLY bottom-left player HUD: add TWO clearly visible equal-length stacked horizontal thin rounded gauge tracks, first HP with WHITE fill and label HP, second SP with CYAN fill and label SP. HP numeric readout '100 / 100' sits above the bars, less oversized than before. Both bars have subtle translucent navy empty tracks. Above health, replace yellow medical cross bonus entirely with the ORIGINAL skill logo from image 2: grayscale double heart shape with tiny HP inside left heart and white '+30' below, preserve its original recognizable silhouette and typography, no yellow cross, no hexagon. This is a skill icon, not a healing notification. Fit the original logo in a subtle dark translucent rounded slot above-left of health. Keep minimalist game HUD spirit. No website, no additional text, no other changes. Landscape 16:9.

prompts.name: 01-scoreboard-cadres
prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: isolated reusable 2D raster HUD sprite for a playable videogame. Input image is STYLE AND SHAPE REFERENCE ONLY, never reproduce the game scene. Generate ONLY the requested fixed UI component on a genuinely transparent alpha background, no checkerboard painted in, no opaque canvas, no scene, no mockup board, no annotations. Front-facing orthographic flat UI, crisp production graphic, modest even transparent margin, asset fills most of canvas along its main axis. Match reference minimalist smoked navy, white and cyan HUD. Dynamic values and variable icons must not be baked into sprite. Request: The TOP CENTER scoreboard backing ONLY: three separate horizontally aligned rounded dark navy translucent rectangles, left small near-square score tile with cyan thin stripe on its OUTER LEFT edge, center wider clock tile, right small near-square score tile with coral pink thin stripe on OUTER RIGHT edge. Same heights, even narrow air gaps, about 3.5:1 total aspect. Completely EMPTY interiors. Remove all scores, timer, FIRST HALF text. These must be placed as a single reusable fixed frame assembly.
